name: Acutaas Chemicals Ltd (Erst. Ami Organics Ltd)
tagline: Genuinely excellent, accelerating three-engine chemicals story (pharma CDMO + electrolyte additives + semiconductor chemicals) - but at ~Rs 26k Cr and ~73x earnings, most of a 10x-from-here is already priced in
business_overview: Advanced pharma intermediates and specialty chemicals maker (formerly Ami Organics) building three verticals: pharma CDMO (Fermion/darolutamide anchor), battery electrolyte additives (VC/FEC), and semiconductor photoresist chemicals (South Korea JV, Indichem).
fundamentals_table: Rs 134 Cr, +114% YoY; PAT margin ~31%; Q4 EBITDA margin ~42%
~25% revenue growth, margins held near FY26 levels
fundamentals_narrative: FY26 execution is genuinely excellent and broad-based: PAT more than doubled, revenue +33%, Q4 EBITDA margin ~42% (pharma ~44%, specialty ~29%). The battery electrolyte-additive capacity (2,000 MT VC+FEC) is sold out on 3-year contracts, and the South Korea semiconductor JV is running ahead of schedule. This is a structural multi-engine expansion, not a single catalyst. But the stock has re-rated ~125% in a year to ~Rs 26k Cr at ~73x earnings, and a 10x from here implies a ~Rs 2.6 lakh Cr outcome.
sentiment_summary: First deep forum read (recent ~50 posts; low posting volume means this spans 2024-2026). Recent 2026 posts cover the Q4 FY26 record print, the sold-out battery capacity, and the ahead-of-schedule Korea JV. Trusted users engaged constructively - abhay.jain (detailed concall notes, no position), PRATEEK_CHANDRA (invested, tracking 3 years, bullish on the semi/EV optionality), Snowman (interested, not invested), AnkitGadia (positive on CDMO 40%+ margins).
community_signal: Chandragupta (elevated, invested) - most recent substantive post (#120, May 2026) flags that management has been 'a little secretive' about the Korea JV partner (later identified via Korean media as ex-Samsung photolithography veteran 'Jay Han' / Han Jae-seong). Two-plus elevated-tier users hold sized positions; no exit calls; the running caution is valuation ('a compelling business at an unforgiving price').
key_new_facts: Sovrenn lead verified: Q4 FY26 sales +40% YoY to Rs 433 Cr, PAT +114% YoY to Rs 134 Cr, OPM stepped up (~28% -> ~42% in Q4); QoQ sales +10%, PAT +26%.
FY26 revenue Rs 1,339 Cr (+33%), PAT Rs 356 Cr (+122%); FY27 guidance ~25% revenue growth with margins held.
Battery electrolyte-additive capacity (2,000 MT) fully contracted for 3 years; South Korea semiconductor JV (Indichem) ahead of schedule; promoter holding has drifted down over 3 years.
bull_case: Three credible, distinct structural growth engines (pharma CDMO, electrolyte additives, semiconductor chemicals) - not a single-catalyst story
FY26 PAT +122% with Q4 EBITDA margin ~42%; battery capacity sold out; Korea JV ahead of schedule
Multiple elevated-tier users hold sized positions
bear_case: ~125% 1-year re-rating to ~Rs 26k Cr at ~73x earnings - much of the growth is already priced
Size (~Rs 26k Cr) makes a further 10x a very high bar
Chandragupta flags management secrecy on the Korea JV partner; Baba Fine Chem acquisition underdelivered vs original promises
Promoter holding trending down over 3 years
verdict_headline: Re-verification: Q4 FY26 confirms genuinely excellent, accelerating three-engine execution, but at ~Rs 26k Cr and ~73x earnings the 10x is largely priced - thesis_fit 'neither' at Medium conviction, with the battery + semiconductor verticals noted as a structural inflection for the max-returns ranking
verdict_reasoning: Re-verification stock (Sovrenn lead). The Q4 FY26 datapoint (PAT +114%, OPM ~28% -> ~42%) is verified and reflects broad-based operating leverage across all three verticals - the 'quality' half of the prior verdict is fully reaffirmed.

Per the large-cap inflection exception, the move into electrolyte additives (largest non-China maker, capacity sold out on 3-year contracts) and semiconductor photoresist chemicals (Korea JV, import-substitution supply-chain play) is a specific structural TAM expansion, not just 'good business' - so it is flagged for the max-returns ranking even though the headline thesis_fit stays 'neither'.

On size and valuation math a 10x-in-2-3-years is not credible from ~Rs 26k Cr at ~73x, so thesis_fit stays 'neither'; conviction stays Medium (genuine quality and trusted holders, balanced against valuation, size, promoter-holding drift and the Korea-JV opacity Chandragupta flags). No red flag; no 30-day revisit.

value_chain.theme: specialty chemicals: pharma CDMO + battery electrolyte additives + semiconductor materials (China+1 / import substitution)
value_chain.position: advanced-intermediate CDMO supplier (Fermion/darolutamide) plus the largest non-China electrolyte-additive maker and an emerging semiconductor-chemicals producer (Korea JV)
value_chain.bottleneck_node: electrolyte additives (VC/FEC) and high-purity semiconductor chemicals outside China
value_chain.note: For electrolyte additives and semiconductor photoresist chemicals, credible non-China capacity is scarce - Acutaas is one of very few Indian entrants, giving pricing power if it executes; the CDMO leg is more contested.

trusted_signals.note: Invested; flags management as 'a little secretive' about the Korea semiconductor-JV partner (later identified via Korean media as ex-Samsung photolithography veteran Han Jae-seong / 'Jay Han'). A transparency nitpick, not an exit.
Invested, tracked 3 years; bullish that the semiconductor + EV-chemical legs (client locked, trials starting) justify the premium if all three businesses scale - execution to be monitored.
"Timex Sh Piston GHFL Nuvama Nippo n Icici amc Uno Minda Acutaas Privi and more stocks have been holding for long time now n pyramiding as well on some triggers like good results" (post #1245)

four_box.note: Three distinct structural growth engines (CDMO, electrolyte additives, semiconductor chemicals) is a genuine tailwind; verdict explicitly flags this as a 'structural TAM expansion' large-cap exception even though headline size (~Rs25,900cr) blocks a literal 10x — tam weak; largest non-China electrolyte-additive maker w/ sold-out capacity is a real moat; ~73x earnings after a 125% 1yr re-rate already prices much of the growth — valuation no.

track_record.note: Screener 10y table FY18-FY26: both rev growth >=10% AND ROCE >=15% cleared in 8 of 9 years; only FY20 failed (0.4% revenue growth). ROCE range 16-34% every year, revenue growth double-digit every year except FY20.

quality_metrics.note: Near net-cash (borrowings Rs36cr FY26 vs EBITDA ~Rs480cr). OPM expanded 18%->23%->36% FY24-26, ROCE 20%->32%->31.6%. Trailing-3y FCF conversion negative (~-32% of EBITDA; CFO Rs125/118/292cr against Rs224-365cr/yr investing outflow) - capex-heavy mid-ramp across pharma CDMO, electrolyte additives and the Korea semiconductor JV; returns are rising as capacity lands, so capex reads productive.

market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: second leg from Korea semiconductor JV + full electrolyte-additive run-rate; ~25-30% revenue/PAT growth
market_expectation.gap_basis: FY27 guidance is ~25% revenue growth with margins held; a 69x multiple needs mid-to-high-30s EPS CAGR. Battery-additive (sold out on 3-yr contracts) and Korea semiconductor JV (ahead of schedule) provide upside optionality but are not yet in guided numbers.
